protein insertion into mitochondrial inner membrane from matrix side
protein insertion into mitochondrial membrane from inner side

definition: The process in which a protein is incorporated into the mitochondrial inner membrane from the matrix side. This includes membrane insertion of newly synthesized mitochondrially-encoded proteins, and insertion of nuclear-encoded proteins after their import into the mitochondrial matrix.
label: protein insertion into mitochondrial inner membrane from matrix
